_comment: Advisories the nightly audit gate tolerates, one entry per pinned package version.
scripts/audit_exceptions.py turns these into --ignore-vuln flags and refuses to run if a lock
no longer pins the version an entry was written for, so an entry cannot outlive the pin it
excuses. Add the ids pip-audit prints for the package (its own id plus every alias, because
which one the PyPI record surfaces varies per package). Never add an entry without a reason
that names the third-party cap or the missing fix release.

exceptions.reason: All eight fix only in pillow 13.0.0, and every Streamlit release up to 1.66.0 caps pillow<13, so the lock cannot hold the fix. Five of them need a TIFF/GIF/PPM/PDF/EPS to be opened; the only decode in this repository refuses those formats (src/xai_utils.py SALIENCY_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS, guarded by tests/test_pillow_decode_surface.py).
exceptions.revisit: scripts/pillow_cap_check.py fails the nightly the moment the pinned Streamlit stops capping pillow<13; then raise the pin and delete this entry.

exceptions.reason: Fixed in 1.5.0, which PyCaret forbids in the all-engine lock (see src/task_catalog.py on why TPOT is not offered).
Fixed in 83.0.0, which dropped pkg_resources; TPOT and autogluon-multimodal import it (requirements-all.in pins setuptools<81 for that reason).
exceptions.revisit: The day neither engine imports pkg_resources.
